title: Ardengard version 1: build plan
rules: Nothing in a phase starts until the PRD is approved and the previous phase's exit check passes.
Every task ships with its tests; every phase ends with /smoketest and a demo you can film.
One work block is one branch and one PR through /gh-ship.
Each phase updates the discussion log and the scorecard.

phases.name: Spikes: prove the unknowns
phases.goal: Answer the questions that could change the design before any real code.
phases.exit: Each spike has a written result in the discussion log and the PRD is updated.

tasks.task: Run the Buzz Compose stack (pinned release) on a test server and record memory, CPU and disk at idle and with one bot.
tasks.done: Numbers recorded; minimum server size set in the PRD.

tasks.task: Connect Claude Code to Buzz with buzz-acp and claude-agent-acp; one bot answers an @mention in a thread.
tasks.done: A screen recording of the reply; setup steps written down.

tasks.task: Find out what happens to Claude Code permission requests under buzz-acp (shown, auto-denied or auto-approved).
tasks.done: Decision recorded: approvals flow through Buzz, Telegram, or our gatekeeper hook.

tasks.task: Log Claude Code in on a headless server and measure how bot usage counts against your plan.
tasks.done: Decision recorded: your subscription with caps, or a separate account or API key.

tasks.task: Drive a Cua desktop container from Claude Code over MCP: open a site, read a page, take a screenshot.
tasks.done: Working example committed; resource cost noted.

tasks.task: Drive a browser from Claude Code with Browser Harness inside the bot's desktop container; run one real website task and compare speed and token use with Cua screenshots.
tasks.done: Decision recorded: Browser Harness, Cua, or both, for website work.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: A new repo and a safe one-command stack with nothing yet clever in it.
phases.exit: Fresh Ubuntu 24.04 server to running stack with one command, reachable only over Tailscale, backups running.

tasks.task: Pick the server for development; create the ardengard repo under a GitHub organization (ardengard-dev or ardengardhq; github.com/ArdenGard is a personal account) with /repo-bootstrap (CI gate, tests, Apache 2.0 LICENSE, SECURITY.md, CHANGELOG); register ardengard.dev.
tasks.done: Repo public or private as decided; CI green on an empty test.

tasks.task: Write the Compose stack: Buzz relay pinned by digest, Postgres, Redis, MinIO, Tailscale sidecar, our bot service placeholder container.
tasks.done: docker compose up works; a test proves no port listens publicly.

tasks.task: Add the startup guard that refuses a public address and the file-permission check (0600 and 0700).
tasks.done: Tests fail on a public bind and on a readable secret file.

tasks.task: Add nightly encrypted backups (restic for files, Postgres dump, SQLite with Litestream) and a restore command.
tasks.done: A restore onto a clean server is tested and passes.

tasks.task: Add update with automatic backup and rollback on failed health check.
tasks.done: A deliberately broken update rolls back by itself.

phases.name: First bot
phases.goal: One Chief of Staff bot that lives in Buzz, defined in git, safe by default.
phases.exit: You message the bot in Buzz, it answers, and every action it attempts asks first.

tasks.task: Define the bot folder format (instructions, skills, tools, model, permissions) and the Chief of Staff bot.
tasks.done: Format documented; the bot loads from its folder.

tasks.task: Wire the bot into Buzz through buzz-acp with owner-only answers and its own key.
tasks.done: Bot answers mentions, threads and DMs; strangers are ignored (tested).

tasks.task: Load skill files in the Agent Skills format; start with two of your existing skills.
tasks.done: The bot uses a skill on request; skill tests pass.

tasks.task: Add bot tests and one-command rollback to the last good version.
tasks.done: A bad edit fails its tests and is not deployed; rollback works.

tasks.task: Start the value log: estimate before, review and fix time after, used without rework yes or no.
tasks.done: Every job produces a value record.

phases.name: Gatekeeper and doorbell
phases.goal: Approvals, limits and the phone doorbell, before bots can do anything real.
phases.exit: Red-team tests show no action runs without its approval, and you can approve from Telegram.

tasks.task: Build the gatekeeper: per-bot allow lists, the never-delegate list, read-only default, Ask on everything.
tasks.done: Tests try each action type without approval and all are blocked.

tasks.task: Untrusted-content quarantine: a turn that read web, email or bot content loses send and settings rights.
tasks.done: A prompt-injection test page cannot make the bot send anything.

tasks.task: Secrets broker: logins filled at use time, never in context, transcripts or logs.
tasks.done: A test searches all logs and transcripts for the secret and finds none.

tasks.task: Pause all, per-bot daily caps on usage and messages, and the one-writer rule per task.
tasks.done: Pause stops a running job within seconds; caps trip in tests.

tasks.task: Telegram doorbell: owner-only bot with approve and deny buttons and the content rule.
tasks.done: An approval from the phone unblocks a job; a test confirms no sensitive fields are sent.

phases.name: Memory and context
phases.goal: Bots that remember correctly and see only what they need.
phases.exit: A bot remembers a fact across days, shows where it came from, and forgets it on request.

tasks.task: Memory server (MCP) over markdown fact files with front matter and SQLite full-text search.
tasks.done: Read, write, search and forget work through MCP; files are readable by you.

tasks.task: Write pipeline: add, update, delete or skip, with history; source, date, scope and expiry on every fact.
tasks.done: A contradicting fact updates the old one instead of duplicating it (tested).

tasks.task: Unverified flag for facts from untrusted sources; they cannot change instructions or permissions.
tasks.done: A poisoned-memory test fails to change bot behavior.

tasks.task: Context recipe per bot: core profile, task, retrieved facts, trimmed tools; handoff note and fresh restart for long sessions.
tasks.done: Token use per turn measured before and after; quality holds on benchmark jobs.

tasks.task: Nightly tidy: merge duplicates, expire stale facts, propose deletions for approval.
tasks.done: Nightly report lists changes; nothing deleted without approval.

phases.name: Computer and long jobs
phases.goal: A Researcher bot that works through websites on its own desktop, for hours if needed.
phases.exit: The prospect-list benchmark job runs overnight, survives a restart, and finishes.

tasks.task: Add the Researcher bot with a shared Cua desktop and browser; you can watch and take over.
tasks.done: The bot completes a multi-page website task with screenshots in the thread.

tasks.task: Job runner with progress file, retries, resume after restart and a 20-minute stall alert.
tasks.done: Killing the server mid-job and restarting resumes the job.

tasks.task: Reviewer step: a separate pass checks output before anything goes to a person.
tasks.done: Incomplete output is sent back, not delivered (tested).

tasks.task: Writer bot and the one-writer handoff from Researcher to Writer.
tasks.done: A two-bot job finishes with a single writer.

phases.name: Observe and harden
phases.goal: See everything the bots do, and attack it before anyone else does.
phases.exit: Traces for every job, a clean /sec-ship, a passing /redteam, and a benchmark scorecard.

tasks.task: OpenTelemetry GenAI traces for every step, sent to the chosen self-hosted viewer; cost and time per job.
tasks.done: Any job can be opened step by step.

tasks.task: Benchmark suite: 5 standing jobs rerun after every change, with the value log.
tasks.done: Benchmark report generated per release.

tasks.task: Red team: prompt injection, tool misuse, memory poisoning, side doors around approvals (promptfoo, garak, /redteam).
tasks.done: Every finding fixed or recorded; zero approval bypasses.

tasks.task: /sec-ship full pass; pin and scan every dependency, image, MCP server and skill.
tasks.done: No open high or critical findings.

phases.name: Release to the community
phases.goal: Something a newcomer can install safely, and the story of building it.
phases.exit: A newcomer installs it from the docs and finishes a first job in under an hour, and release 1 is published.

tasks.task: First-run setup: creates one safe example bot and explains each permission it asks for.
tasks.done: A clean install reaches a working example bot with no manual edits.

tasks.task: Docs site for people who have never run a server; safe defaults and risks explained plainly.
tasks.done: A newcomer test run under 60 minutes.

tasks.task: Signed release with changelog; the install refuses versions with known advisories.
tasks.done: Release 1 published and verified from a clean machine.

tasks.task: You run release 1 yourself long enough to film the demo.
tasks.done: Demo recorded; problems found are fixed before sharing.

tasks.task: Public scorecard and build-log posts drafted through /post for your approval.
tasks.done: Scorecard page live; posts in Desk for approval.
